versions.subject: new susp service installation rules
versions.detection:
selection:
  Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - '/Create'
    - '/RU "NT AUT'
    - '/TR'
    - 'C:\Users\'
    - '\AppData\Local\'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="*/Create*" CommandLine="*/RU \"NT AUT*" CommandLine="*/TR*" CommandLine="*C:\\Users\\*" CommandLine="*\\AppData\\Local\\*"
